title: FUSE PANEL ASM & DIMMER SWITCH
summary: Mounting of the fuse panel (fuse block, part of the instrument panel wiring harness) on the dash panel (firewall) under the instrument panel, with the hazard flasher plugged into it, and of the floor-mounted headlamp dimmer switch (foot dimmer switch) on the lower dash panel. The fuse panel is screwed to the dash panel with screws into plates; the dimmer switch is held by a rivet and a screw assembly into a plate.

parts.name: PLATE
parts.name_expanded: Plate – fuse panel mounting (on dash panel)

parts.name: SCREW
parts.name_expanded: Screw – fuse panel to dash panel

parts.name: SWITCH ASM-DIMMER
parts.name_expanded: Headlamp dimmer switch assembly (foot dimmer switch)

parts.name: PLATE
parts.name_expanded: Plate – dimmer switch mounting (behind dash panel)

fastening.to: dash panel, into plate [1] at the upper hole
fastening.note: Screw [3] goes through the upper mounting hole of the fuse panel into the dash panel at plate [1]. The fuse panel's lower hole lines up with a second hole near the RIVET (UPC-1) callout; the fastener there is not called out separately.
Plate [1] sits on the dash panel at the fuse panel upper screw location; drawing shows two small holes in it but no separate fastener callout.
Hazard flasher [2] plugs into the socket at the top of the fuse panel; no fastener.

fastening.to: lower dash panel, with plate [7] behind
fastening.note: Dimmer switch [5] is held to the lower dash panel by rivet [4] and screw assembly [6]; their holes line up with plate [7] on the other side of the panel.
Plate [7] backs the dimmer switch fasteners on the opposite side of the dash panel; drawing shows multiple holes but no separate fastener for the plate itself.

notes: FUSE PANEL ASM (PART OF INSTRUMENT PANEL WIRING HARNESS).
notes_internal: Item 2 has two extra lines 3904868 and 3934200 marked only 'OPT.'; which option each belongs to is not stated.
How plates [1] and [7] are attached to the dash panel is not clearly shown.
